purpose: Immutable prospective capture records, not historical reconstruction or model input admission
reuse: v7_research_artifacts.strict_json and existing immutable bundle patterns
intent_required: externally retained immutable expected intent identity
source_calendar_universe_label_scope: Not inferred by this capture prototype; source response session/field/unit QC, qualified historical calendar/universe/lifecycle and labels need separate W07/data approval before research
clock_candidate: Final market observations only: planned<=request<=receipt; observation<=publication<=source_available<=receipt<=QC<=candidate_freeze<=decision_deadline, timezone-aware. Broader event types need separate review. No actual times chosen.
missing: Record expected source/session failure without raw/zero invented; no missing source can become eligible
late: Retain actual receipt/QC afterfreeze as LATE, never rewrite old snapshot; no posthoc backfill labelled timely

modes.FORWARD: Prospectively registered intent and actual acquisition; caller claim not authentication
modes.RECOVERY: Later recovery under distinct identity; retain actual receipt time, never promote to timely
modes.BACKFILL: Retrospective source/session; retain actual retrieval and original gap, not original asof vintage

revision: New immutable raw/manifest/record; retain old pinned bytes, new revision and prior link; lineage claims require external validation
prototype_result: PROTOTYPE_TIMELY means declared clocks/pins and local integrity consistent ONLY; research_admitted=false/historical_asof_verified=false ALWAYS
trust_limitations: Trusted stable local archive root; not a malicious concurrent filesystem boundary
Caller may backdate all fields/re-hash: consistency does not prove real-world chronology; no such output becomes asof evidence
Publication/QC references only metadata format here, not their content/authenticity
No complete dated calendar/next-open/prediction-time validation; reuse W07 plus Human-approved policy later
No actual immutable pre-fetch intent writer, trusted clock monitor or network collector enabled
minimum_future_qc: HTTP success/schema and requested response identity
Security/units/session/segment and bounded OHLCV checks, no unknown zero-fill
Raw/manifest byte verification and immutable intent/record publication
Missing/late/error ledger, revision pinning and independently traceable trusted acquisition clock/logs
Rights-qualified source/use and approved freeze/deadline/missing policies
unresolved_human_decisions: Allowed source API/open-data/contract and research/storage/redistribution rights
Storage/restore/retention and clock/intent audit evidence sufficient for future admission
Approval of any forward collection execution, research or training
